command: (()=>{const t=document.querySelector('#paperItemTable');if(location.pathname!=='/paper/modify.donga'||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('paperId')!=='1094'||document.querySelector('.modal.show')||[...t.querySelectorAll('tr[data-item-id]')].map(e=>e.dataset.itemId).join(',')!=='2089242,2089243,2089244,2089245,2089238'||!window.Sortable?.get?.(t))throw Error('Exact local owned groups required');window.__qa1094PointerEvents=[];let overs=0;for(const type of ['pointerdown','pointerup','mousedown','mouseup','dragstart','dragover','drop','dragend','start','end','update','sort'])t.addEventListener(type,e=>{if(type==='dragover'&&overs++>20)return;window.__qa1094PointerEvents.push({type:e.type,isTrusted:e.isTrusted,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,oldIndex:e.oldIndex,newIndex:e.newIndex,targetTag:e.target.tagName});},true);const rect=e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,width:r.width,height:r.height};};return {scopeReady:true,visibility:document.visibilityState,focused:document.hasFocus(),source:rect(t.querySelector('tbody:last-of-type [data-sort-handle]')),target:rect(t.querySelector('tbody:first-of-type tr:first-child [data-seq]'))};})()
